artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exhaustive verification for \(H_2\) over \(\mathbb F_2\) and \(\mathbb F_3\) using only exact finite-field arithmetic.

limitations: The all-rank theorem is mathematically correct but is not an original finding because an earlier published record already contains the same general formula, the same symplectic classification, the same rank transition, and the same extraspecial-group corollary.
record_title: Exact subalgebra commutativity degrees for finite Heisenberg Lie algebras
